name: UWA Workplace Qualification Reimbursement Program
summary: Up to $150 back on RSA, First Aid or Barista training for domestic UWA students, with priority for those in hardship.
who: Domestic students; international students can apply only for First Aid through Study Perth
Priority will be given to students facing financial hardship
how: Get pre-approval through the application form, then book and pay for training
catches: Pre-approved students must provide a tax invoice and certificate of completion to UWA within 30 days
